method: Every row is a brief paraphrase from a web-search-indexed Dúchas transcript excerpt, with original printed CBÉS folio labels provided by the index. The Dúchas site returned an access verification challenge when opened, so folio facsimile, full page, writer/informant metadata, continuation text and administrative locality are NOT certified. Multiple reported steps in the same narrative are not separate customs. Folklore supernatural claims must never be endorsed. May seasonal practices may have folklore or non-Christian dimensions; religious approval cannot be assumed. Some workbooks share transmitters/informants; independent local witness status cannot be inferred. Copyright of original collection respected via tiny original action paraphrases and citation URLs.

sources.source_metadata_status: CBÉS 0378 p.189 independently corroborated by search-indexed original page metadata; full folio still not opened
